scope: Bounded USB lifecycle/performance observation; not a calibrated timing model or acoustic/physical-button acceptance

installed_identity.method: Read-only ROM partition table and 288-byte application header/descriptor; no MAC/NVS/identity reads or flash writes
installed_identity.scope: Descriptor match, not a full Flash content checksum

method.inputs: FAP_KEY_V1 through the existing input queue, no screenshot during timed runs; initial concatenated log lines retain the input field, and ACK values are matched against the entire sent-key sequence
method.frame_filter: Only windows wholly within playing intervals, at least 0.5 s after entry; partial title/entry windows excluded
method.audio_filter: Discard initial buffered/partly pre-session windows (report time < 5.5 s); separately exclude the first usable window after startup/idle from the steady-rate range
method.limits: No write/format failure, panic/watchdog/overflow markers; each sent command must be acknowledged. Rates and window timings are observations, not predeclared performance targets.

unverified: per-frame P95/P99 and worst-case CPU time
effective audio headroom and initial prefill
physical button timing and speaker quality
